parsed.core_themes: This folder contains records concerning the formal acceptance and accreditation of diplomatic and consular representatives in Brazil during 1963, in the final period of João Goulart’s presidency before the March 1964 coup. Records filed here would likely address the presentation and recognition of ambassadors, ministers, and consuls, including letters of credence presented to the president and exequaturs authorizing consular officials to act. They may reflect exchanges between the U.S. Embassy in Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian Foreign Ministry (Itamaraty), and the Department of State over appointments, credentials, protocol, and the status of U.S. representatives in Brazil. The folder’s subject is diplomatic procedure rather than policy negotiations, but accreditation correspondence can illuminate official channels and bilateral representation amid Brazil’s political instability and changing government.
